name: Effect of Concentration on an Equilibrium
subject: chemistry
ncert_reference: NCERT textbook portal; Class 11 equilibrium activity page to verify
educational_goal: Observe a reversible color change and relate it qualitatively to a change in reactant concentration.
safety_notes: Use teacher-prepared dilute solutions and goggles.
Do not perform with concentrated reagents.

gaps: The supplied Class XII chemistry units do not specify this record's complete procedure and doses; original values are unchanged.
